Activate sustained formalization of Route 03. Start the strict exterior-energy estimate and the marked-boundary construction in parallel, then pursue descent on the original smooth manifold. Read and execute the launch prompt in:

/smooth-poincare-4d/formalization/investigations/03_single_cut_descent/continuation-notes/CONTINUATION.md

I’ll read the Route 03 launch prompt and check the current Lean build, then start the exterior-energy estimate and marked-boundary construction in parallel. I’ll track which hypotheses each result still needs for descent on the original smooth manifold.

The strict estimate holds even when the cap error uses the full allowance \(\eta=\delta\). For the marked cut, the two patch maps must agree on an open collar so their derivatives match across the seam. I’m using that collar to construct the diffeomorphism that pulls the compactified metric back to \(M\).

Lean now constructs the diffeomorphism from the marked open patches and proves it preserves the tangent orientations. The fixed-cut proof also chooses one radius at which every sufficiently late source index satisfies both exterior tests. I’m checking how far descent can be stated using the actual Riemann curvature of the pulled-back metric.

The descent theorem now uses the Levi–Civita curvature of the pulled-back metric. In paired oriented orthonormal frames, Lean proves equality of the curvature coefficients and equality of the Yamabe constants. The remaining geometric inputs include the cap estimates and the realization of the marked charts on the selected sequence. I’m checking the assembled public theorem and blueprint.

All 132 Route 03 declarations passed the public-import type and axiom checks. The audit also clarified the scope of the variational bound. Lean transfers the curvature energy in the frame carried by the diffeomorphism. Identifying the resulting infimum with the manuscript’s intrinsic \(I^+(M)\) still requires a proof for arbitrary oriented orthonormal frames.

**Lean now proves conditional one-cut descent on the original smooth manifold.** Given the cap estimates and recognition principle for the specified exterior, the marked collar charts, and the component residual estimates, `oneCutDescent` constructs an orientation-preserving diffeomorphism \(\Phi:M\to\widehat X\) agreeing with the prescribed map on the protected core. Its pullback of the compactified metric has positive Yamabe constant and curvature energy exactly \(e_X\). [OneCutDescent.lean](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/formalization/FirstOrderTwistor/OneCutDescent.lean)

The strict exterior estimate holds even when the cap error uses the full allowance \(\eta=\delta\), provided \(e_X>T=4\pi^2\). At \(e_X=T\), strictness requires \(\eta<\delta\). Lean checks the equality example and proves that one can choose the buffer length, then a fixed radius, so that every sufficiently late source index passes both the energy and Yamabe tests. [Integration record](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/formalization/investigations/03_single_cut_descent/research-progress/handoffs/INTEGRATION_20261125.md)

The verified variational conclusion is \(I_{\mathrm{fr}}(M)\le e_X<e\), which excludes this cut at an exact minimum. A supplied uniform Yamabe deficit strengthens the decrease to \(e_X\le e-\kappa_\delta\). Neither proof uses a whole-neck energy identity. Here \(I_{\mathrm{fr}}\) uses integrable curvature energies in pointwise oriented orthonormal frames. Identifying it with the manuscript’s intrinsic \(I^+(M)\) still requires arbitrary-frame independence and integrability. The main geometric task remains to produce the marked core and cap estimates on the **same cut** of an approximately critical sequence. [Dated continuation](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/formalization/investigations/03_single_cut_descent/continuation-notes/AFTER_MARKED_DESCENT_20261125.md)

The default build passed. All 132 Route 03 declarations passed the public type and axiom audit, and the PDF and web blueprints rebuilt successfully. Public chat capture was unavailable for this thread. [Blueprint, Theorem 6.8](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/formalization/blueprint/print/print.pdf)
